name: comp-212
blurb: Select field that shrinks and grows with content.
description: A shadcn Select with w-auto and min-w-48 classes, allowing the trigger width to adjust based on the selected option while maintaining a minimum width.
use_when: Content length varies and you want the field to breathe without taking full width.
avoid_when: Layouts requiring consistent column widths or when full-width forms are needed.
a11y: Standard select behavior; width changes are visual only.
